records.title: OmniScope: Modality-Decoupled Token Compression for Omnimodal Large Language Models
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract describes modality-decoupled token compression and reports lower prefill compute/memory cost for omnimodal LLMs.

records.title: RAT: Bridging RNN Efficiency and Attention Accuracy via Chunk-based Sequence Modeling
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract presents chunk-based recurrent/attention sequence modeling aimed at retaining attention accuracy with improved memory efficiency.

records.title: TNT: Improving Chunkwise Training for Test-Time Memorization
records.reason: The primary abstract focuses on speeding chunkwise training for test-time memorization (including a training speedup); it provides no concrete LLM inference, serving, or deployment-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Stuffed Mamba: Oversized States Lead to the Inability to Forget
records.reason: The official arXiv v1 title matches the candidate; the current v3 title was changed under the same arXiv ID. Its abstract discusses state capacity and forgetting in long-context modeling, but the concrete inference-system efficiency connection is limited, so retain as borderline.

records.title: RheoSampling: Resolving the One-Hot Dilemma in Stochastic Dynamic-Tree Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract describes stochastic dynamic-tree speculative decoding that reduces verification overhead while preserving exact output distribution.

records.title: Faster LLM Inference via Sequential Monte Carlo
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract directly targets faster LLM inference with sequential Monte Carlo speculative decoding.

records.title: Adaptive Request Scheduling for CodeLLM Serving with SLA Guarantees
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract studies adaptive request scheduling for CodeLLM serving with SLA guarantees and improved goodput/latency.

records.title: High Throughput and Low Latency LLM Serving via Adaptive KV Caching
records.reason: The official ACM primary abstract describes adaptive KV caching to improve LLM serving throughput and first-token latency.

records.title: ThriftAttention: Selective Mixed Precision for Long-Context FP4 Attention
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract studies mixed-precision FP4 attention for long-context inference, reducing attention memory/compute while recovering quality.

records.title: CFSP: An Efficient Structured Pruning Framework for LLMs with Coarse-to-Fine Activation Information
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract presents structured LLM pruning using activation information to reduce model cost.

records.title: GoodSpeed: Optimizing Fair Goodput with Adaptive Speculative Decoding in Distributed Edge Inference
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract presents adaptive speculative decoding and scheduling for distributed edge inference goodput.

records.title: LoSA: Locality Aware Sparse Attention for Block-Wise Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract presents locality-aware sparse attention to reduce active-token attention work in diffusion language models.

records.title: CodeQuant: Unified Clustering and Quantization for Enhanced Outlier Smoothing in Low-Precision Mixture-of-Experts
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract presents clustering/quantization and kernel optimization for low-precision MoE inference.

records.title: TempoKV: Timely Staging of LLM KV Caches for Memory-Semantic Flash
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract studies timely staging of LLM KV cache across memory-semantic flash to support serving under capacity constraints.

records.title: Symbiosis: Multi-Adapter Inference and Fine-Tuning
records.reason: The primary arXiv abstract describes multi-adapter inference and fine-tuning with shared base-model resources and improved GPU utilization.
